messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

yo! 

love the casual vibe but i need to know who you actually are to help you out

what's your full name?
Robin

robin... solid name, works for any gender which i respect

where you working these days?
In a remote company

"remote company" tells me nothing robin... 

which company? name drop time
Yo

yo yourself...

listen robin, i can't help you find roles if you won't tell me where you work. it's not that deep - just need your company name so i can find your linkedin and see what you're about

which company? or are we playing 20 questions here?
Buddy I already told you

nah robin, you said "remote company" which is like saying "i work at a building"

that's not a company name. i need the actual name - like "google" or "zomato" or "some startup i've never heard of"

what's the company called?
Are you serious? I already shared the name of the company above

robin... i'm looking at our entire chat. you said:

"In a remote company"

that's not a company name. that's just telling me you work remotely.

look, maybe there's some confusion here. i need an actual company name like "microsoft" or "swiggy" or whatever startup you're at. without it, i can't find your linkedin or help you with roles.

so one more time - what's the name of the company you work for?
It's a remote company

robin... look, i get that you work remotely. that's the work setup.

but "remote company" isn't a company name. it's like saying "i work at an office building" instead of "i work at google"

is there a reason you don't want to share your actual company name? or should i just ask for your linkedin url directly so we can move forward?
Yo

robin... we're going in circles here

look, either drop your linkedin url or your resume. can't match you with roles if i don't know anything about your background

which one you got - linkedin or resume?
Yo, Delete my history

yo robin, i can't delete chat history - that's not how this works

but if you want a fresh start, just tell me your name and we'll go from there. or if you're done here, that's cool too

what's it gonna be?
I am done here

fair enough robin. hit me up when you're ready to actually find a job

peace ✌️
